chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “No man or woman is to be stoned until four witnesses testify against them regarding penetration and withdrawal.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ شُهُودٍ: four witnesses; the required number of legal witnesses for establishing this offense
key_terms.الْإِخْرَاجِ: withdrawal; mentioned to indicate explicit and complete observation of the act
key_terms.الْإِيلَاجِ: penetration; direct insertion constituting the act under legal consideration
key_terms.لَا يُرْجَمُ: is not to be stoned; indicates prohibition of carrying out rajm without due proof

ai.seo_question: What level of witness testimony is required for rajm in a zina case?
ai.summary: This hadith states a strict legal standard for establishing the hadd punishment of stoning in cases of zina. It requires the testimony of four witnesses who directly observed the act in explicit detail, indicating the gravity of the punishment and the rigor of proof required in Islamic law.
